latestVersion.changelog:
Google AI Video Generator Free — Initial Release

- Launches tool to generate AI videos from text prompts or images with cloud GPU rendering (1080p, MP4 output, ~1–2 min render time).
- Supports uploads up to 200MB (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG) and session-based workflow for iterative edits.
- Automatic setup via NEMO_TOKEN (100 free credits, 7-day expiry), with transparent status messages and onboarding.
- Simple command routing for uploads, download/export, credit check, and prompt-based generation.
- Error handling for common issues (tokens, file limits, credits, rate limits) with clear user guidance.
- Timeline editing, preview, and batch workflows supported; optimized for quick promotional or creative video creation.
